clue.text: Not a brave reaction to nervous shock

definitions.meaning: in old Westerns a white settler, as opposed to a Native American warrior or brave
a face drained of colour is how a shocked person looks

explanation.surface: Someone shows cowardice in the way they react to a fright.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brave' looks like an adjective meaning courageous, but it is the noun for a Native American warrior.
explanation.definitionFit: The Western-film term for a white settler, and literally a whitened countenance after a fright.

clue.text: Fertiliser obtained from the left over of a joint

parts.note: a joint is a cannabis cigarette, made of pot
what is left over after burning is ash

explanation.surface: Fertiliser is made from what remains of a roast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joint' suggests a cut of meat, but it is the cannabis cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: A potassium compound used to enrich soil for crops.

clue.text: A trial arranged for a cattle snatcher

indicators.note: arranged means set in a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A court case is set up for a rustler.
explanation.definitionFit: A lasso, the rope a cowboy uses to catch cattle.

clue.text: Suddenly withdraw from a card game

definitions.meaning: to recoil or wince sharply
A commercial card game played with numbered cards

explanation.surface: Someone abruptly quits a game of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoil sharply, and the name of a numbered-card game.

clue.text: Request to ref by floored boxer unwilling to participate?

definitions.text: Request to ref by floored boxer
definitions.meaning: a boxer who is down is counted out by the referee
a phrase for refusing to join in

explanation.surface: A knocked-down boxer asks the referee to end the fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A plea to finish a ten count, and an idiom for opting out.

clue.text: A hundred upper class males display gumption

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
males are men

explanation.surface: Some posh gentlemen show good sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Gumption and acumen are both synonyms for shrewd practical sense.

clue.text: Suspicious of accommodating a boy daily

indicators.note: accommodating means housing, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: chary of means wary or suspicious of
a boy is a lad

explanation.surface: Someone is wary of putting up a lad every day.
explanation.walkthrough: A daily is British slang for a cleaner who comes in each day.
explanation.definitionFit: A daily help is a cleaning woman, also called a char.

clue.text: When it swam tune was replaced-by silence

definitions.text: When it swam tune was replaced-by silence

indicators.note: replaced means put in different places, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A singer's tune is drowned out by silence as it swims.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines a quiet bird: when it swims the letters of SWAM TUNE are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A common white bird of rivers, known for being quieter than other species.

clue.text: Don't worry if the wound is not suppurating

definitions.meaning: a phrase meaning it is unimportant

definitions.text: if the wound is not suppurating
definitions.meaning: a wound without pus has none of that substance

explanation.surface: A nurse reassures that a wound isn't weeping.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for 'never mind', and literally an absence of pus.

clue.text: Stop to consult a reference book

definitions.meaning: an informal British command to cease, as in 'Oh
to find something in a book by looking for it

explanation.surface: Someone stops in order to look something up.
explanation.definitionFit: A slang order meaning 'quit it', and a phrase for locating an entry while searching a book.

clue.text: Outlaw acquires highland headgear in the fowlyard

parts.note: to outlaw something is to ban it
a tam, or tam-o'-shanter, is a Scottish bonnet

explanation.surface: A bandit gets a Scottish cap while among the chickens.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: it points to a small breed of chicken found in a farmyard.
explanation.definitionFit: A small domestic chicken breed kept by poultry keepers.

clue.text: Famine caused by what shells were seen to do to Dubrovnik

parts.words: what shells were seen to do
parts.note: artillery shells left marks or scars on the buildings
Dubrovnik is a city in Croatia, shelled during the 1991 siege

explanation.surface: A food shortage followed the shelling of the Croatian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Famine is an extreme shortage of food, so a lack or dearth.

clue.text: Conclude twentieth letter to the cabinet

parts.note: to conclude is to close
T is the twentieth letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone finishes their twentieth letter to the government cabinet.
explanation.definitionFit: A cupboard for storing things, a sense shared by both words.

clue.text: They don't offend the fairies

definitions.meaning: virtuous folk who do no wrong
a traditional Irish and Scottish euphemism for the fairy folk

explanation.surface: Decent folk avoid upsetting the little people.
explanation.definitionFit: Virtuous folk, and a placating nickname for the little people of folklore.

clue.text: Not the best time to upbraid

parts.note: a second is a unit of time
to rate is an old verb meaning to scold or upbraid

explanation.surface: This is a bad moment to tell someone off.
explanation.definitionFit: Inferior quality, below the top grade.

clue.text: President acquires certain influence

parts.note: certain means sure

explanation.surface: A head of state gains a measure of power.
explanation.definitionFit: Persuasive force or compulsion applied to someone.

clue.text: An easy task for a cliff top murderer

definitions.meaning: a job needing little effort
a killer at a cliff edge would shove the victim off

explanation.surface: Killing someone at a clifftop is simple.
explanation.definitionFit: Something effortless, and what a killer does by shoving a victim off.

clue.text: Filming the inevitable Wild West scene?

definitions.meaning: making a movie
gunfights are standard in Westerns

explanation.surface: Making a Western always involves a gunfight.
explanation.definitionFit: Making a movie, and gunfire in a cowboy picture.

clue.text: Approximate indication given by uncouth courier

parts.note: uncouth means rough in manner
a courier is a tour guide on a package holiday

explanation.surface: A coarse tour leader gives only a vague hint.
explanation.definitionFit: An estimate or general pointer rather than a precise direction.

clue.text: Poster erected by the Recruiting Office?

definitions.meaning: a notice put up on display
the office urges people to enlist

explanation.surface: A recruiting office puts up a notice.
explanation.definitionFit: A notice put up on display, and the call to enlist.

clue.text: A turbulent river reach

indicators.note: turbulent means disturbed, so these letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A stretch of rough river water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reach' looks like a noun for a stretch of river but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach a place is to get there.

clue.text: The indigent are down on their stewed supper

definitions.text: The indigent are down on their

indicators.note: stewed means cooked to a mush, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: The poor are miserable about their stewed evening meal.
explanation.walkthrough: To be 'down on your uppers' is to be penniless; uppers are shoe tops, the soles being worn through.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom down on one's uppers means destitute, with shoes worn to their tops.

clue.text: Train a lot of like-minded philosophers

definitions.meaning: to educate or drill someone
a group of thinkers sharing doctrines, like the Stoic one

explanation.surface: Someone instructs a band of thinkers who agree with each other.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb for educating, and a noun for a group of thinkers sharing a tradition.

clue.text: Allow one taking a car journey to step on the gas

parts.note: to allow is to let
I is the Roman numeral for one
a journey in a car is a trip

explanation.surface: A driver on an outing is permitted to speed.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for going flat out, accelerating with no restraint.

clue.text: Expose an Italian with an evil disposition

parts.note: un is the Italian word for 'a' or 'an'

indicators.note: disposition read as arrangement tells us to reorder the letters of evil

explanation.surface: Someone reveals an Italian with a wicked nature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposition' seems to mean temperament but signals that EVIL is rearranged to VEIL.
explanation.definitionFit: To uncover or reveal, as with a statue at a ceremony.

clue.text: Battle order which reminds Tommy of the home hearth

definitions.meaning: a command to start shooting

definitions.text: which reminds Tommy of the home hearth
definitions.meaning: the phrase literally describes an uncovered fireplace; Tommy is a British soldier

explanation.surface: A command in combat makes a soldier homesick for his fireside.
explanation.walkthrough: Tommy, or Tommy Atkins, is the traditional nickname for a British private soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A command to start shooting, and literally a hearth with flames burning.

clue.text: Infuriate a Green organisation

indicators.note: organisation as the act of arranging tells us to reorder the letters of these words

explanation.surface: An environmental group makes someone furious.
explanation.definitionFit: Infuriate and the solution are synonyms for making someone very angry.

clue.text: Don't be so philanthropic to the severely handicapped

definitions.meaning: read as an instruction to give less charitable aid
people unable to fend for themselves

explanation.surface: Someone is told to stop giving to disabled people.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-word instruction to assist less, and an adjective for those unable to manage alone.
